skill.name: agy-worker
skill.description: Use when Codex or Claude Code should delegate repository exploration or implementation to Google Antigravity CLI (agy), then review, verify, repair, and deliver the result.
skill.summary: Delegate bounded repository tasks to Antigravity CLI, then independently review changes and record verification results.
skill.author: cagdasyurekli

security_audit.summary: All 400 presented findings were adjudicated; most are syntax, documentation, validation, or controlled local tooling. Confirmed verifier execution and semantic session, Keychain, and network boundaries require explicit trust; no evidence found of malicious exfiltration or audit-directed prompt injection. The reported 280 unpresented matches remain unadjudicated and require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/680 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 280 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Driver verification runs candidate code with host authority.
remediation.suggestion: Offer an OS-isolated verification path with denied network, minimal credentials, and read-only host mounts; retain candidate snapshots as evidence, not confinement.

remediation.issue: Session mode retains ambient hooks, plugins, and unrestricted host authority.
remediation.suggestion: Require a distinct acknowledgement for ambient execution and offer a disposable restricted account or supported native containment for untrusted repositories.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain grants are not limited to provider credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated provider-only Keychain or credential broker that limits operations and items; preserve explicit approval for remaining exposure.

remediation.issue: Native TCP 443 and listener permissions exceed a provider destination policy.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce reviewed destinations through an egress proxy or external firewall, and disable listener grants when the workflow does not require them.

remediation.issue: The static review catalog omits 280 reported matches.
remediation.suggestion: Complete manual adjudication of the omitted matches before automatic publication; do not treat these 400 verdicts as full-catalog clearance.

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Tasks and Verify Changes
content.value_statement: Delegated repository changes need clear scope and independent verification. This skill coordinates approved Antigravity CLI jobs, bounded repairs, and driver-owned acceptance.
actual_capabilities: Run explore, task, and project workflows with explicit cycle and runtime budgets.
Preview provider-readable content and bind approved launch settings to a digest.
Stage selected files in private Gitless directories and reconcile authorized changes.
Track job status, preserve reviewable candidates, and resume approved worker conversations.
Run driver-selected checks and bind verification receipts to candidate state.
Record final assurance without automatically committing or publishing changes.
limitations: Requires Bash, Python 3, Git, and an installed Antigravity CLI with provider access for live work.
Approved repository content may reach Google/Gemini; secrets must be excluded before launch.
Session mode and ordinary verification do not isolate host access; native provider containment requires supported macOS conditions.
Offline readiness and worker reports do not establish authentication, correctness, or complete test coverage.

use_cases.title: Explore an Unfamiliar Repository
use_cases.description: Delegate focused discovery, then spot-check findings and report coverage limits before planning implementation.

use_cases.title: Add Bounded Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Limit worker edits to reviewed test paths, inspect the candidate diff, and verify against the existing test suite.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Project Repair
use_cases.description: Run approved repair cycles, preserve partial work, and record independent build, test, and lint results before finalization.

prompt_templates.title: Check Local Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Report missing prerequisites. Do not launch a provider or inspect account settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: validate prerequisites without provider transmission

prompt_templates.title: Preview Focused Exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an explore workflow for [question] in [repository]. Preview only [approved paths], model, and budget. Wait for exact transmission approval before dispatch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a bounded exploration launch

prompt_templates.title: Implement and Verify a Small Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker for [bounded change]. Restrict writes to [paths]. Obtain exact launch approval, review the diff, and independently run [driver-selected checks].
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: implement a scoped change with independent checks

prompt_templates.title: Manage Bounded Repair and Finalization
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a project workflow for [goal] with [cycle budget]. Request approval for scoped repair and isolation. Preserve candidates, bind verification, and finalize with remaining gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate approved repair cycles and assurance

best_practices: Select only necessary files and direct tests, then review the exact task, destination, isolation, model, and budget before approval.
Keep credentials, logs, controller state, and private verification manifests outside provider-readable content.
Inspect the actual candidate diff and use independent checks in an isolated verification copy before recording final assurance.
anti_patterns: Treating worker-reported commands, test claims, or a valid output envelope as proof of correctness.
Assuming a disposable worktree or scoped staging prevents session-mode access to the rest of the host.
Silently changing scope, isolation, model, budget, or implementation ownership after provider failure.

faq.question: Which assistant tools can drive this skill?
faq.answer: The package supports Codex CLI and Claude Code. It does not provide a standalone interface for the Claude application.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: Bash, Python 3, Git, and Antigravity CLI are required. Live dispatch also requires provider access.

faq.question: Does installation authorize sending repository content?
faq.answer: No. Live work requires human approval for the task, exact provider-readable content, destination, isolation, model, and budget.

faq.question: Does scoped mode sandbox the worker?
faq.answer: No. Scoped staging limits selected content and reconciliation. Session mode retains normal host authority; native containment has separate macOS requirements and limits.

faq.question: Does a passing gate prove the change is correct?
faq.answer: No. The driver must inspect the diff and choose relevant checks. The gate does not isolate ordinary verification or detect every external side effect.

faq.question: How should failed or incomplete work be handled?
faq.answer: Preserve reviewable candidates and report verification gaps. Use approved repair cycles; do not silently switch to direct implementation after a hard stop.
